themes.note: The frontmatter colours are the light theme. Each colorMeta entry carries its dark value in `dark`. Both are defined as hex in src/styles/tokens.css, which is the source of truth and is contrast-tested.

dark.purpose: The dim evening kitchen: designed for low glare, not derived by inverting light.

themes.selection: data-theme is set on the root element before first paint, from localStorage key recipeflare:theme or else the device's prefers-color-scheme.

title-lg.purpose: The page title on a phone, and the wordmark in the header and on the rail.

title.purpose: A recipe's title in a row and a list item's name; at 700, the letter on a tile and an empty state's heading.

body.purpose: Running text, with tabular figures. At 600, a secondary list name and a text link.

body-sm.purpose: The meta line under a recipe title, a list item's detail, the note beside a page title.

label.purpose: Divider tabs, the notice band, status lines, the tag in a meta line.

label-nav.purpose: The label under an icon on the phone navigation bar; 700 for the current destination. The smallest text in the system.

typeScale.name: --rf-text-cook
typeScale.status: Defined for cook mode's step text; no shipped screen uses it yet.

shadows.name: stock-band
shadows.purpose: The band of its own stock along the top of a selected divider tab. A band of colour, not elevation.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: For surfaces that float over the page, such as a menu or dialog. Defined; no shipped component uses it yet.

motion.name: rf-motion
motion.purpose: Every state transition: background, text and border colour, height and box-shadow.

motion.name: skeleton-sweep
motion.purpose: The loading sweep across skeleton rows, from skeleton through surface-sunk.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Applied to everything when the device asks for reduced motion.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: 768 px: navigation moves from the bottom bar to the left rail, the phone header is removed, stack margins grow to 1.5rem, the page title steps up to 1.75rem.

focusRing.purpose: One ring everywhere; white on the navy header and rail.

layout.safeArea: The header pads to env(safe-area-inset-top) and the bottom bar to at least 0.5rem or env(safe-area-inset-bottom).

states.tabHover: filter: brightness(1.05) on an unselected divider tab

icons.appIcon: public/icon.svg is a placeholder: an index card with a buff divider tab and a red rule on ink navy. The final icon and wordmark are unresolved.

stockAssignment.rule: By the category's position in the household's list, modulo five; plain is for All and for a recipe with no category.

enforcement.checks: Text pairs at 4.5 to 1 and graphic pairs at 3 to 1 in both themes; every token defined in dark; no token named soft, muted or ending -text; ink, surface, ground, rule and shell differ between themes; dark stocks stay close to light stocks.
Every colour class in a source file names a colour the Tailwind theme defines; the default palette is cleared.

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Recipe Tin"**

Recipeflare is the household's index-card recipe tin. It is an index you thumb through, not a gallery you browse. Most of the family's recipes come from paper and have no photograph, so the system does not use the photo-card grid; a recipe is a ruled row with a lettered tile in its category's colour. The colours are the colours of index cards, and each has a job: ink navy for the tin and all text, card white for the working surface, ruling blue for every hairline, one rule red, and five divider-stock colours for categories.

It is built for a phone propped on a kitchen counter, read at arm's length and touched with messy hands. That sets the density and the sizes: body text is 17 px, a recipe title 19 px, every control at least 44 px, and six or more recipes fit on a phone screen because rows are ruled and not boxed. One typeface, Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, is used throughout because it was drawn to be read at a distance.

The tin is evoked by colour and structure only. There is no paper texture, no handwriting font and no serif display type. The owner does not want it to read as a generic business app or as a food magazine or blog.

The source of truth is `src/styles/tokens.css`. Components use Tailwind classes generated from those tokens (`bg-surface`, `text-ink`); the default Tailwind palette is cleared, so a colour the theme does not define produces no CSS, and a test fails on any such class. No component contains a hex colour or a `dark:` variant.
keyCharacteristics: One ink for all text; hierarchy by size and weight.
Ruled rows on card white, hairlines in ruling blue, no shadows.
Divider tabs over the card stack; a category owns one stock colour everywhere.
Rule red in two places only: the line under a page title, and adding a recipe.
Every target at least 44 by 44 CSS px.
A dark theme designed for a dim kitchen, with its own values.
Self-hosted type and icons, because the kitchen may have no network.

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: All text is `ink` (or the matching `on-` colour on a fill). Hierarchy comes from size and weight. There is no grey, muted or "soft" text token, and `tokens.test.ts` fails if a token named `soft`, `muted` or ending `-text` is added. Do not lower opacity to get a second tone either; the only opacity in the system is 0.55 on a disabled button.

rules.name: The Two Jobs Rule
rules.body: Rule red does two things: it is the line a title sits on, and it marks adding a recipe. Save, cook and confirm use the primary button. Delete is a quiet ink-outline button with a bin icon. Errors and warnings go in the notice band with an icon, never in red text or a red border.

rules.name: The One Stock Rule
rules.body: A category keeps one stock colour wherever it appears: tab, tile, and any later chip. Get it from `assignStocks()` in `src/ui/stock.ts`; never pick a colour per screen. There are five stocks. A sixth category shares the first one's stock.

rules.name: The Tested Pairs Rule
rules.body: Every text pairing is checked at 4.5 to 1 and every meaningful line or ring at 3 to 1, in both themes, by `tokens.test.ts`. A new colour token arrives with its pairings added to that test.

rules.name: The Weight, Not Grey Rule
rules.body: Three weights do the work: 400 for reading, 600 for names and controls, 700 for titles and the current place. Within the recipe meta line the tag is 600 and the rest 400; that is how one line carries two levels in one ink.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: No second family, no serif display, no handwriting or script face, no monospace. Labels are sentence case; nothing is set in capitals or letter-spaced.

rules.name: The 44 Rule
rules.body: Every link, button and tab is at least 44 by 44 CSS px (`--rf-touch`, 2.75rem). Navigation items are 52 px (`--rf-touch-nav`, 3.25rem). A row that is a link is the whole row.

rules.name: The One Index Rule
rules.body: The recipe list is the home screen. There is no dashboard.

rules.name: The Ruled, Not Carded Rule
rules.body: Rows are separated by 1 px hairlines in ruling blue. A row, a stack, a tile and a button have no shadow. The overlay shadow is for things that float over the page and for nothing else.

dos: Do take every colour, size, radius and touch size from `tokens.css` through the Tailwind theme classes. Add a token, with its contrast pairings in `tokens.test.ts`, before using a new colour.
Do set all text in ink and build hierarchy from 400, 600 and 700 and the eight sizes.
Do get a category's colour from `assignStocks()` and use it on that category's tab and tiles everywhere.
Do separate rows with a 1 px ruling-blue hairline on card white, and show hover and press by changing the ground to `surface-sunk`.
Do put a page's title on the 2 px red rule at the top of its card stack.
Do make every link, button and tab at least 44 by 44 CSS px, and make a row that leads somewhere a link across its whole width.
Do design each screen in both themes; check the dark one as a dim kitchen, not as a copy of light.
Do pair every icon with words, and use bundled Lucide icons at stroke width 2.
Do give every screen its loading (skeleton rows), empty (empty state), error and offline (notice band) states.
Do honour reduced motion: transitions and the skeleton sweep stop when the device asks.
donts: Don't add a grey, muted or soft text colour, or fade text with opacity.
Don't use rule red for save, cook, confirm, delete, errors, links, badges or decoration. It is the title rule and adding a recipe.
Don't show a problem as red text or a red border. Use the notice band with an icon.
Don't put recipes in shadowed cards or a photo grid. Don't add a shadow to a row, stack, tile or button.
Don't add paper textures, torn or lined-paper effects, handwriting or script fonts, or serif display type.
Don't pick a category colour per screen, or add a sixth stock; colours repeat after five.
Don't write a hex colour or a `dark:` variant in a component. Don't use a default Tailwind colour such as `bg-gray-100`; it produces no CSS.
Don't load a font or an icon from a network service. The app must work offline.
Don't derive a dark value by inverting or dimming the light one without checking its pairings.
Don't build a dashboard or a second home screen. The recipe list is the index.
Don't use the word Cloudflare or its flare shapes in the name, icon or logo, and don't borrow Mealie's look or copy.
